🔥 The fire settles. Angelo has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you — I put it down today." "It crouches low, tail lashing once, twice. The stripes go still. Then it comes." "A paw rises, claws out — casual, almost lazy. It is not lazy." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ruth says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Aria says quietly "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

📡 VILLAGE STANDING — the System has noticed Haven. A village that fights, feeds, builds, befriends and explores is a village worth watching. The lesser seat is priced on what you did, not on one dinner.

🐪 A river trader walks into Haven a day early — word of the village's standing travels faster than feet. "Heard Haven's name on the river," they say, pack heavy, smile practiced. "Thought I'd see it for myself."

You catch Nadia telling the fire about Roberto. "Roberto came back mauled by the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still (6 rounds, 42 taken) and alive. A limp that comes back in the cold now." The story's already growing.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall.
